subject.work: Martin Heidegger, Das Realitätsproblem in der modernen Philosophie

lexical_index.claim_ceiling: Lexical distribution does not establish conceptual identity, absence or historical continuity.

minimal_positive_kernel: Methodical inquiry begins by suspending presumed self-evidence.
Psychic act, ideal content and intended object must not be conflated.
Experience and thinking jointly constrain the determination of reality.
Subject-conditioned perceptual contents do not exhaust the real.
Scientific determination is progressive yet remains structurally incomplete.
strongest_rivals: A transcendental account can explain objectivity without determining things in themselves.
A structural or empiricist account can retain stable relations without full commitment to hidden relata.
Intersubjective communicability may presuppose the shared world it is used to establish.
next_gate: Analyze Neuere Forschungen über Logik (GA 1, pp. 17–43) with the same page-aware pipeline, then test whether the act/content/object distinction is a stable local bridge rather than a retrospective developmental narrative.
